newsitem.title: JAPAN: Okinawa refinery restarts after typhoon.
newsitem.headline: Okinawa refinery restarts after typhoon.

text.p: Japanese refiner Nansei Sekiyu KK said it resumed operations at its Nishihara plant in Okinawa, southern Japan on Tuesday, after closing the refinery on Sunday due to a typhoon.
The 100,000 barrel-per-day refinery was closed as typhoon Yates approached Okinawa in a precautionary measure to ensure the safety of the refinery workers, Nansei Sekiyu KK said.

Yates veered off Japan this morning, the meteorological agency said. Typhoon Zane was south of Shikoku, in southern Japan, as of 0300 GMT. Zane is moving in an east-northeast direction and is likely to pass without hitting Japan, it said.
